limitations: Backend parity covers the CPU-only JAX build and Dask over NumPy; no accelerator device was exercised, consistent with PERF-001.

Config-case and rejection-probe input digests are taken over the canonicalized document, with the volatile temporary workspace prefix replaced by the literal <workspace>, so each digest names the scientific input rather than the host path.

The retained commands are the Stage-1 focused pytest module set, ruff lint, ruff format --check, and the docstring doctests; the remaining Section 9 gates (whole unit and integration suites, typecheck, the docs build, and the Tier-8 release acceptance module) are not retained here.

This record was measured and generated on macOS x86_64 under Rosetta 2 using the locked osx-64 environment, because Section 8.1's extended-width predicate is unsatisfiable on the project's default osx-arm64 environment where NumPy longdouble aliases float64 and complex256 does not exist.
